body.prompt: Photorealistic industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized handheld digital camera, 57 mm wide, 39 mm tall, 33 mm deep. Use image[1] for the exact proportions, the 3/4 front view from slightly above and the feature layout: lens with a 16 mm ring right of centre at 41 % of the height, small square flash window upper left, round shutter button and a small slide switch on the top left above the grip, USB-C port on the right side face. Matte light-grey 3D-printed PLA with dark-grey accents, crisp edges, clean part lines, believable to 3D print.
